heading: A live EB-5 visa webinar for investors from Brazil

details.text: Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 6 p.m. in New York.
75 minutes on Zoom, presented in Portuguese.

bodyText: The EB-5 visa is the path to a green card for people who invest at least $800,000 in a U.S. business. In this EB-5 visa webinar, Helena Prado, a U.S. immigration attorney, and Rafael Moura of Litora show where the money goes and when it can come back, and take questions at the end.
